title: Workday agrees to acquire C1.ai, formerly known as ConductorOne, which develops enterprise software to manage human and AI agent identities and has raised $111M (Malia Spencer/Portland Business Journal)
summary: Malia Spencer / Portland Business Journal: Workday agrees to acquire C1.ai, formerly known as ConductorOne, which develops enterprise software to manage human and AI agent identities and has raised $111M — Software company C1, whose headquarters has fluctuated between San Francisco and Portland, is being acquired by California-based Workday Inc.
